settings.text: Everything you need to know about your LUMA ritual, your order, and our promise to you.

settings.question: How long until I see results?
settings.answer: Most people notice a visible glow and softer skin within 2 weeks. Full results — smoother texture and deeper hydration — typically appear at 4–8 weeks of daily use.

settings.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Yes. Our formulas are fragrance-free, non-comedogenic and dermatologist tested. As with any new product, we recommend a quick patch test on your inner arm before first use.

settings.question: How do I use my products?
settings.answer: Apply to clean skin morning and night. Start with your lightest texture (serum) and finish with moisturizer. A little goes a long way — 2–3 drops or a pea-sized amount is plenty.

settings.question: Can I use it during pregnancy or breastfeeding?
settings.answer: Our core formulas are made with pregnancy-friendly ingredients, but every body is different — we always recommend checking with your doctor before starting any new skincare during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

settings.question: Is LUMA cruelty-free and vegan?
settings.answer: Always. LUMA is 100% vegan and never tested on animals — at any stage.

settings.question: How should I store my products?
settings.answer: Keep them somewhere cool and out of direct sunlight, with the lid closed. No need to refrigerate.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: Shipping is free on all orders over $50. Orders under $50 ship at a flat $4.95. Express options are available at checkout.

settings.question: How long will my order take?
settings.answer: Orders are processed in 1–2 business days. Standard delivery then takes 3–6 business days, and express 1–3 business days.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship worldwide. International orders usually arrive within 7–14 business days. Any customs or import fees are the recipient's responsibility.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: You'll get a tracking link by email the moment your order ships. Allow up to 48 hours for tracking to begin updating.

settings.question: What's your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day glow guarantee. If you're not in love, email us within 30 days of delivery for a full refund — even on opened products. See our Shipping & Returns page for details.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards, plus Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal at checkout.
